title: unified-rollouts-add-preflight-e2e-and-stability-guards-for-shadow-canary-autorollback
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Several recent production incidents showed that shadow-canary autorollback can be triggered by noisy downstream metrics and intermittent probes. This PR introduces a preflight e2e test harness for unified rollouts and implements stability guards in the autorollback engine to reduce false-positive rollbacks. Scope: 1) Add preflight e2e suite that runs staged shadow and canary scenarios against the rollout controller in a CI job; 2) Add quorum-based metric evaluation and transient-window smoothing to autorollback decision logic; 3) Add observability hooks (new telemetry tags and dashboards) and documentation for operators; 4) Add unit and integration tests for the new logic. Checklist: - [x] New e2e tests that simulate fluctuating latency/error rates and verify no spurious rollbacks - [x] Implemented quorum metric aggregation with configurable window and quorum threshold - [x] Added transient-window smoothing to ignore short-lived spikes - [x] Added feature flag to enable/disable enhanced safety guards per-cluster - [x] Updated rollout docs and added runbook notes - [x] CI job wired (ci/circleci:e2e-rollouts) Notes: the description below contains the high-level change list, the commits, and review summary. This PR intentionally keeps default thresholds conservative to avoid masking real regressions; thresholds and windows are documented and can be tuned per-customer. Related: ENG-4123 (reduce autorollback flapping), SUP-1123 (support case root cause investigation).
commits: feat(rollouts): add quorum-based metric aggregator and transient smoothing
test(e2e): add preflight e2e scenarios for shadow and canary flows
chore(ci): add ci/circleci:e2e-rollouts job and orchestration script
docs(rollouts): document safety guards and tuning parameters
perf(rollouts): minor optimizations to metric evaluation loop
review_comments: Liam Chen: Can we add a short-circuit for sampling rates < 0.1% to avoid noisy aggregated metrics? I think we should guard the quorum for extremely low-volume tenants.
Aisha Patel: Added sampling-rate short-circuit in quorum_aggregator.go and included a unit test. We default to 0.2% sampling threshold; configurable via cluster config.
Priya Rao: The e2e job flaked once in CI with a probe timeout. Suggest increasing probe window in the test harness to avoid false negatives.
Aisha Patel: Increased probe window and added retry/backoff in the test harness. Re-ran e2e locally and in CI.
Daniel Kim: LGTM overall. Left a minor nit about log message verbosity in decision_engine.go; not blocking for merge.
Liam Chen: Approving after e2e pass. Verified dashboards and runbook changes.
ci_checks: ci/circleci:e2e-rollouts - failed on first run (probe timeout), rerun passed
release_notes: Add preflight e2e tests for unified rollouts and introduce quorum-based metric aggregation and transient-window smoothing to reduce false-positive autorollbacks. Includes observability dashboards and operator docs. No breaking changes.
summary: Adds preflight e2e tests and safety guards (quorum + smoothing) to autorollback logic to improve stability for shadow-canary rollouts.
